% ==================================================================
%  Monte Carlo flights under bounded sensing noise -- one sigconf text width
%  (8.2 cm), pdfLaTeX, plain TikZ (no pgfplots; coordinates are embedded)
%  Data:      cpp2lean sim/out/montecarlo-noise-L2/runs/<lean|ref>-<i>.csv.gz and summary.csv
%             (sim/montecarlo.py --noise L2): the 200 starts and headings of
%             sim/out/montecarlo, flown by copter_lean and copter_ref with the sample
%             perturbed every tick by independent errors uniform in [-b, b] per
%             component (spec sensing level L2: bp 0.02 m, bv 0.05 m/s, bq 0 deg,
%             bw 0 rad/s, bf 0 m/s^2), the same noise for both vehicles of a pair;
%             the true positions are drawn. The two vehicles' positions are equal on
%             every tick (checked by the script). Contract holds on 200 of 200 copter_lean
%             and 200 of 200 copter_ref runs. Levels that pass everything: L1, L2; drawn: L2.
%             Each trajectory thinned to 200 points (largest-triangle-three-buckets).
%  Top:       top view as montecarlo-paths.tex: corridor of radius 0.25 m (the path
%             stroked with round caps and joins), the box A, the waypoints, the
%             trajectories as translucent strokes. Largest distance to the path after
%             leaving the box over all runs 20.43 cm.
%  Bottom:    the spread: at each tick the largest distance over the runs from the
%             run's position to the nominal flown path (sim/out/lean-course-1ms), log
%             scale, the whole run (0 to 30 s). At t = 0 19.74 cm; largest after
%             3 s 8.91 cm at t = 18.875 s.
%  Generated by cpp2lean sim/figs/make_montecarlo_noise.py; no hand-edited coordinates.
% ==================================================================

  axis/.style={draw=fwHair, line width=0.4pt},
  mk/.style={draw=fwHair, line width=0.4pt},
